title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: Created two contrasting data visualizations using U.S. abortion data to support and challenge the proposition that a handful of states provide most of the nation's abortions. Explored how design choices, including data selection, visual emphasis, and framing, can influence how viewers interpret the same data.

title: Processed Chicken: What Are We Really Paying For?
description: Created a data visualization comparing the price and nutritional value of raw versus processed chicken using GroceryDB data. The visualization and accompanying written analysis explored differences in price, protein, sodium, and fat.

title: Perceived Healthiness vs. Nutritional Content in Recipes
description: Analyzed Food.com recipe data to investigate how nutritional characteristics relate to perceived healthiness. Conducted exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, and feature engineering, then developed and tuned a Random Forest classifier to predict whether recipes were labeled healthy.

title: Isotretinoin Ocular Side Effects Research
description: Collaborated on a research project investigating the potential ocular side effects of isotretinoin. Developed a Python-based simulated data generator and explored statistical analysis and visualization techniques, including correlation heatmaps and violin plots, to prepare for analysis of real patient data.
